title: IT IS NOT RED
text: IT IS NOT RED. IT IS ORANGE

product_metadata.title: TMOST Butter Dish with Lid for countertop Ceramics Butter Keeper Container Dishwasher safe Ideal Gift for family & friends
features: This butter keeper is made of high-quality ceramic, which is thick and smooth. It’s a very practical tableware for butter and serving snacks. And their colors are bright and colorful, making them also very suitable for Christmas decorations at home.

TMOST butter dish with cover, designed with knob and non-slip base, make it is easy to hold. There's also a small ridge on the dish so that the butter stays in the middle of the dish and keep the lid from dropping.

Our porcelain butter container measures 5.11"x 3.54"x 1.57" which is wide and deep enough to fit a wide range of shaped sticks of butter. TMOST butter dish with cover works perfectly for 2 sticks of East Coast butter or 1 cube of West Coast/ European butter.
This butter dish is dishwasher safe, microwave safe, and easy to clean.
This cute ceramic butter dish will be a lovely present for your family or friends on Christmas, Mothers' Day, Fathers' Day, New Year's Day, or for Housewarming.
